The woman, dressed in black leggings, a white multi-pocket fishing vest, and a navy wide-brimmed hat, holds a tall fishing rod and gestures toward the man with an impatient facial expression. (3) A circular frame displays a professional portrait of a woman with short reddish hair smiling warmly while wearing a pink top. Below this frame, stylized icons for liking and subscribing appear on a white background with falling autumn leaf graphics.
